title: stellaria graminea var. brachypetala
intro: Stellaria graminea var. brachypetala, commonly known as lesser stitchwort or dwarf stitchwort, is a variety of the flowering plant Stellaria graminea. It is a herbaceous perennial plant that grows in moist meadows and woodland edges. The health benefits of Stellaria graminea var. brachypetala include its use as a diuretic and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to reduce swelling and relieve urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
